name: birdix
features: Classic mode: claim 80 percent of the grid while dodging enemy birds, with level, claimed percent, lives and score shown.
Free paint mode lets the bird fly free and paint, with clear and export.
Stained glass mode draws lead lines with wander, hunter, bounce and tracer autopilots and jewel fill.
Photo glass mode turns an uploaded photo into stained glass.
Cityscape mode generates a city that can be regenerated and exported.
Retry and main menu work after losing.
